contract: A stale content read must not prune IDs from the newer query snapshot, including IDs shared by both queries.
fixture: Old query waits on shared-id; newer query installs 30 hits with shared-id on page two; old read returns null; page two must retain shared-id and total 30.

verification.mutation: Removing only the post-await isCurrent guard makes the named regression fail; original helper bytes restored in finally and equality asserted.

limits: Mutation probe validates one temporal guard; not complete concurrency acceptance
